changelog_text:
**Fixes the crash of 0.5.0 on KSA 2026.11.16.5901 and later.**

- **0.5.0 crashed the game on 2026.11.16.5901 and later** (seen on 2026.11.25.5949) as soon as a Kerbal sat in a seat: `Method not found: AnimatedRenderable.SetAnimation(IAnimation, Single)`. The release was built against the game files of 2026.11.10.5801, where `SetAnimation` has two parameters; the newer builds have a third. This version is built against 2026.11.25.5949, so it runs on 2026.11.16.5901 and later, and no longer on 5801.
- Nothing else changes from 0.5.0.

Built against KSA 2026.11.25.5949 and StarMap 0.5.2.

listing.name: Character Manager
listing.abstract: Choose which character mods your crew roster draws from, and give recruits the names and fixed crew their mod provides.
listing.description:
Choose which character mods your crew roster draws from, and give recruits the names and fixed crew their mod provides.

**It does nothing on its own.** It manages the characters that other mods add, such as KSP Characters, and works with any character mod.

Open it in game from **View > Mods > Characters**. The features, and the format for character mod authors, are in the [README](https://github.com/paulo-santana/KSA-Character-Manager#readme).
